hooks.command: staged=$(git -C "$CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR" diff --cached --name-only 2>/dev/null); if printf "%s\n" "$staged" | grep -qE "^(app|lib|components)/" && ! printf "%s\n" "$staged" | grep -qx "docs/STATUS.md"; then printf '{"systemMessage":"Strategy-as-code: staged changes touch app/, lib/, or components/ but docs/STATUS.md is not staged. Update docs/STATUS.md to reflect what changed (operating rule 3), or confirm no status change is needed before committing."}'; fi
